test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which state produced the highest cotton in India in the year 2019-20?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It **produces 29.78 percent **of the **total cotton production **of **India**.
 
• It is also called ‘Cottonpolis of India’.
 
• **India **is the **world’s largest producer **of **cotton**.
 
• The **states of Gujarat**, **Maharashtra**, **Andhra Pradesh**, **Haryana**, **Punjab**, **Madhya Pradesh**, **Rajasthan**, **Karnataka**, and **Tamil Nadu **are the **major cotton-producing **areas in **India**.
 
• **Nearly two-thirds** of **cotton production in India comes **from the **states of Maharashtra**, **Gujarat**, **Andhra Pradesh**, and **Telangana **- collectively known as the **Cotton Basket of India**.
 
• The **United States Department of Agriculture **(USDA) pegs **India's cotton production at 29 million **bales in 2019-20.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cotton **is a **soft, fluffy staple fiber **that **grows in a boll**, or **protective case**, around the **seeds **of the **cotton plants **of **the genus Gossypium **in the **mallow family Malvaceae**.
 
• **The fiber **is **almost pure cellulose** and can **contain minor percentages **of **waxes, fats, pectins, and water**.
 
• **Cotton **is a **natural fiber **that **grows on a plant**.
 
• It is **both a food **and **fiber crop**, and the **plant is a leafy**, **green shrub **related to the **hibiscus species of plants**.
 
• There are **up to 52 species **of **cotton **in the **Gossypium genus**.
